stories.title: Sources: Rivers-to-NC State deal set to be finalized after Friday board meeting
stories.summary: Philip Rivers is set to return to NC State, this time as head football coach, once its trustees finalizes his contract after a meeting Friday, sources said.

stories.title: Brewers' Misiorowski, Yanks' Schlittler crowned unanimous Cy Young winners
stories.summary: Milwaukee's Jacob Misiorowski and New York's Cam Schlittler capped dominant 2026 seasons by sweeping all 30 first-place votes to win their respective Cy Young Awards.

stories.title: Warriors' Curry injures abdomen vs. Rockets, ruled out
stories.summary: Warriors star Stephen Curry was ruled out of Wednesday's game in Houston after injuring his right abdomen in the first quarter.

stories.title: Cousins: O'Connell convinced me to accept trade to Vikings, 'Kevin knows me'
stories.summary: Kirk Cousins has rejoined the Vikings after not quite three years away, relishing his familiarity with the Twin Cities area, the people in the organization.

stories.title: Mendoza relishes 'once-in-a-lifetime' opportunity, had 'no inkling' of Cousins deal
stories.summary: No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza said Wednesday it's a "once-in-a-lifetime" opportunity to be the Raiders' starting quarterback, while his teammates and coach expressed their confidence in his ability to lead the offense.
